title: General terms
slide_intent: Introduce the scope of a brand-use policy before its detailed rules. Readers need to know which materials and names a policy covers.
strategic_value: Slack can gather different kinds of brand features under one set of terms and name the marks treated by this edition.
demonstration: Three lettered passages define the scope and the marks. A nested list illustrates that scope with five names, including Slackbot and Where Work Happens.
practical_value: Use this page to locate the 2020 guide’s definitions before interpreting its later examples or restrictions.
